analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.10) vs SMA5 ($1.02)/SMA20 ($1.03)/SMA50 ($1.07) — Confirmed above short- to mid-term trends.
· Below SMA100 ($1.15)/SMA200 ($1.28) — Indicates weakness in long-term trends.
· 52-week position (5.1%) + Current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.5→62.0) — Confirmed exit from oversold, entering neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0044→0.0059) — Improvement confirmed, signaling potential trend reversal upwards.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band $1.03) — Bandwidth at 12.50% suggests expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.06) — Support zone based on Pivot (PP) and SMA50.
· Swing resistance ($1.13) — Potential for further upside if 5-day high ($1.11) is breached.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day high $1.11, 20-day high $1.11) — Pattern attempting to break out after consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (4.28x) — Provides strong confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Conditions met for entry with RSI exiting oversold and significant volume surge.
